## Business Promotional Products and Corporate Gifts in Chennai

[![trademark](https://hausergifts.com/assets/data/trademark.jpg)](https://hausergifts.com/#)

**Welcome to Hauser&Co**, the branded advertising & corporate gift specialists since 30years. We aim to cost effectively produce merchandise that will assist your business make a statement and get noticed by clients.

We service an expanding client list with on budget, on time and on specification Promotional Marketing Solutions. In short - we are big enough to make your large order happen but are small enough to care about everyday smaller orders also.

[View More](https://hausergifts.com/#)

## What we do

Our growing reputation is centred around our belief in supplying the best quality products at value prices with excellent customer service.

1. **Quality Products**


    We understand that Promotional Products and Clothing are mini billboards for your brand. As such we maintain minimum quality thresholds, if it's cheap and unfit for purpose we simply will not sell it, we concentrate on quality products for effective long term promotions.
2. **Customer Service and Advice**


    A central part of what we do is offer clients good quality advice about our products and how to use them effectively. You can only do this by having years of product knowledge and a sound understanding of the principles behind marketing. We guide you from the beginning to delivery of your product.
3. **Best Prices**


    We monitor our online competitors pricing to ensure our costs are lower. If you see a similar looking product for less but want our quality and customer service we will always try to better that price!
